description: Internal, for provider-claude-code; denied to agents and never called by the apps. Account `account`'s Claude Code access token, from where its sign-in lives now: ~/.claude for the global account, its folder for any other (the login Keychain on macOS). `account` is an account id, never `global`: resolve the global one with tmux::accounts::list first. When the token expires within five minutes, the worker renews it first, as Claude Code does, and only then: under the swap gate and swap.lock (so no switch moves the sign-in under it), then Claude Code's own locks in that store (.oauth_refresh.lock, the legacy realpath(dir).lock, .storage-write.lock), it reads the sign-in again (a Claude Code may have renewed it), renews it with its refresh token at Anthropic's token endpoint and writes it back to the same store, atomically; one renewal per account at a time. On macOS that write is the Keychain's, which needs the worker in the person's GUI session. This is the only function that returns a token, and the worker renews no other. Errors are one JSON object `{code, message}`: `unknown_account`, `not_signed_in`, `token_expired` (Anthropic refused the renewal, or the sign-in holds nothing to renew with: sign in again), `busy` (Claude Code or a switch held the sign-in for more than 10 seconds) or `failed` (anything else, e.g. Anthropic not reachable while the token no longer works).

response_schema.description: An account's access token. No `Debug`: it is never logged.

access_token.description: Its OAuth access token, for `Authorization: Bearer`.

account.description: The account the token is for.

expires_at_ms.description: When the token expires (milliseconds since the epoch); asked for again before then.

response_schema.title: CredentialOutput
